en.title: Automotive R&D Assistant Chatbot
en.summary: Recommender system with retrieval, grounding, and policy-aware responses for automotive R&D.
en.challenge: Automotive R&D users needed a private assistant that could retrieve engineering evidence, preserve internal knowledge boundaries, and provide useful answers without sending sensitive content to a public model service.
contribution: Designed local-first RAG and GraphRAG retrieval over domain documents and structured knowledge.
Built the Chainlit conversational experience, retrieval pipeline, prompt controls, and Docker runtime.
Connected LLM, graph, vector, and document services behind a modular Python application.
technical: Ollama provides local model execution; vector retrieval and graph relationships contribute evidence.
Python orchestration combines query understanding, retrieval, context assembly, and response generation.
Chainlit delivers the chat UI while Docker keeps the full environment reproducible on-premises.

architecture.label: Conversation
architecture.detail: Chainlit captures engineering questions and displays sources and answers.

architecture.label: Retrieval
architecture.detail: RAG and GraphRAG search documents, metadata, and knowledge relationships.

architecture.label: Generation
architecture.detail: A local Ollama model receives bounded evidence and domain prompt instructions.

architecture.label: Deployment
architecture.detail: Docker services keep data, application, and model execution inside the controlled environment.

outcomes: Demonstrated private, grounded GenAI assistance for engineering work rather than a generic chatbot.
Combined document retrieval and graph relationships to improve traceability and context.
Created an on-premises-friendly architecture aligned with sensitive R&D constraints.

zh.title: 汽車研發助理聊天機器人
zh.summary: 為汽車研發打造具檢索、溯源與政策約束的推薦助理。
zh.role: 生成式 AI 與知識工程師
zh.challenge: 汽車研發人員需要一套私有助理，既能檢索工程證據、維持內部知識邊界，又不必將敏感內容傳送至公有模型服務。
contribution: 針對領域文件與結構化知識，設計以本地運作為優先的 RAG 與 GraphRAG 檢索流程。
建置 Chainlit 對話體驗、檢索管線、提示詞控制與 Docker 執行環境。
以模組化 Python 應用程式串接大型語言模型、圖譜、向量與文件服務。
technical: Ollama 負責本地模型推論，並由向量檢索與圖譜關係共同提供證據。
Python 編排層整合查詢理解、檢索、上下文組裝與回覆生成。
Chainlit 提供聊天介面，Docker 則確保完整環境可在內部部署並重現。

architecture.label: 對話
architecture.detail: Chainlit 接收工程問題，並呈現來源與回答。

architecture.label: 檢索
architecture.detail: RAG 與 GraphRAG 搜尋文件、詮釋資料及知識關係。

architecture.label: 生成
architecture.detail: 本地 Ollama 模型只接收受限證據與領域提示詞指令。

architecture.label: 部署
architecture.detail: Docker 服務讓資料、應用程式與模型推論都留在受控環境內。

outcomes: 展示適用於工程工作的私有且具依據之生成式 AI 助理，而非一般聊天機器人。
結合文件檢索與圖譜關係，提升可追溯性與上下文品質。
建立符合敏感研發限制、適合內部部署的系統架構。
